content_sections.heading: About KV Meghahatuburu
content_sections.text: Kendriya Vidyalaya Meghahatuburu is a school run by Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS). This interview fills its need for part-time contractual teachers in the 2026-27 academic session.

content_sections.heading: KV Meghahatuburu Post Graduate Teacher Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the interview builds a panel, and teachers are engaged purely on a part-time contractual basis as and when required. A consolidated payment is made every month. The rate for a Post Graduate Teacher (all subjects) is Rs. 32,500 per month. Contractual teachers do not get vacation pay. Payment during the autumn and winter breaks is worked out under KVS norms. Teachers are not paid for any working day on which they are absent. Pay for days absent from duty is calculated under KVS norms. Remuneration and working hours follow KVS norms. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: KV Meghahatuburu Post Graduate Teacher Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 65 years. Candidates need (a) and (b) below, plus (c): (a) An Integrated Post Graduate Course from an NCTE-recognised institution or university in the concerned subject, with at least 50% marks in aggregate including the B.Ed. component; OR a Master Degree from a recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the concerned subject. (b) A B.Ed. Degree from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks; OR a three-year Integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks; OR a four-year Integrated Degree with at least 50% marks from an NCTE-recognised institution or university, including a B.Ed. component. (c) Proficiency in teaching in both Hindi and English medium. Experience as a TGT in the concerned subject at a recognised institution Experience of working in a school Knowledge of computer applications The notice says educational qualifications follow KVS norms. For any question about eligibility, check KVS Recruitment Notification No. 01/2025 (PDF) , which the notice names as the reference, together with the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility for the post.

rows.subject_s_at_post_graduation_level: In the concerned subject or any specialisation in the concerned subject, provided the candidate has also studied the concerned subject at graduation level

rows.date: From 10:00 AM onward (page 2); Annexure-A says the process starts from 09:00 AM

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by a walk-in interview. Original documents are checked at the interview, and the selected names go onto a panel. The school engages teachers from this panel when a need arises. Being on the panel gives no right to a regular appointment in KVS.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contractual teachers stay engaged until a regular teacher joins or the academic session ends, whichever comes first. If their performance is not satisfactory, their service can end earlier. They have no claim or right to a regular appointment and are not part of the Kendriya Vidyalaya teachers' cadre. Even when a vacancy exists, a candidate cannot claim an appointment. Engagement depends entirely on need. Dress code: teachers must be clean and trim and must not dress casually or informally on duty. Their dress must be neat and dignified. Contract teachers perform all the duties of regular teachers, including: Teaching their subject to the standards of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan and CBSE Checking classwork, homework, examination papers and project work on time Setting question papers for the tests and examinations given by the examination department Preparing lesson plans and keeping students' academic records Preparing students for study-related activities, home activities and cultural competitions Escorting students to activities outside the school when needed Any other work the school assigns

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KV Meghahatuburu Post Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register and apply on the KVS Samvida-Sathi portal . Registration is mandatory, and only valid applications received through the portal are considered. Download the completely filled application form (bio-data form) from the portal. If you are applying for more than one post, send a separate application for each. Bring the form and the documents listed below to the walk-in interview on 4 November 2026. The registration and completely filled bio-data form from the KVS Samvida-Sathi portal Self-attested photocopies of all certificates All original certificates (for verification only) A valid photo ID proof A recent colour passport-size photograph No travel or other allowance (TA/DA) is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which subject is KV Meghahatuburu recruiting a PGT for?
faq.answer: History. Page 2 of the notice lists Post Graduate Teacher - History as the only post.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need to register online before the walk-in?
faq.answer: Yes. You must register on samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in to appear, and only valid applications received through the portal are considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for a contractual PGT?
faq.answer: A consolidated Rs. 32,500 per month. There is no vacation pay, and you are not paid for days you are absent from work.

faq.question: Q4. What marks do I need in my Master Degree and B.Ed.?
faq.answer: At least 50% marks in aggregate in the Master Degree in the concerned subject (or the integrated PG course) and at least 50% in the B.Ed. or the integrated B.Ed. course.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for PGT History if I did not study History in graduation?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires History or a specialisation in History at post-graduation level, and the subject must also have been studied at graduation level.

faq.question: Q6. Is teaching experience required?
faq.answer: No, it is only desirable. The notice lists TGT experience in the concerned subject at a recognised institution, experience of working in a school, and knowledge of computer applications as desirable.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: Until a regular teacher joins or the academic session ends, whichever is earlier. The service can end sooner if performance is not satisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get travel allowance for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does selection lead to a permanent KVS job?
faq.answer: No. The panel is only for part-time contractual engagement and gives no right to a regular appointment in KVS or a place in the teachers' cadre.
